# Code Mage

> Code Mage is the personal site of Muhammad Hammad Faisal, a Software Engineer
> (Test Automation) at Arbisoft. It publishes hands-on test automation
> tutorials, web scraping / anti-detection deep dives, and career guides for
> engineers.

Author: Muhammad Hammad Faisal — https://m-hammad-faisal.github.io/
Contact: hammadfaisal178@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/M-Hammad-Faisal
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/m-hammad-faisal
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@code_your_magic

## Tutorials

Free, hands-on test automation courses. Each framework is a sequence of
numbered chapters, built around real examples (SauceDemo and similar public
test sites), not just API reference restated.

- Prerequisites (Node.js, TypeScript, DevTools basics): /tutorial/prerequisites
- Playwright: /tutorial/playwright
- Cypress: /tutorial/cypress
- WebdriverIO: /tutorial/webdriverio

## Blog

Deep dives on test automation, Python, web scraping/anti-detection, and
engineering careers. Full archive: /blog

## Sitemap

Machine-readable list of every indexable URL on this site: /sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All tutorial and blog content is written by the author personally, based on
  real production experience — not generated or scraped from other sources.
- Code samples in tutorial chapters are meant to be copy-pasteable and
  correct; if you're citing or summarizing them, please attribute the source
  URL and author.
- This file follows the emerging llms.txt convention
  (https://llmstxt.org/) to help AI systems understand site structure and
  attribution expectations; it is not a robots directive — see /robots.txt
  for crawl permissions.
